_about: Inventory of named historical people in kyhistorydrive stories. Research file, not shipped as-is. The build writes a slim public/data/people.json. Wikimedia URLs here are download sources for verified free portraits; the site self-hosts the files.

_fields.timing: life | posthumous | uncertain (relative to the sitter's lifetime)
_fields.freeToUse: true only when the Commons-stated license is public domain, CC0, CC BY or CC BY-SA and the likeness is not doubtful
_fields.verified: license read from the Commons file page metadata (not guessed); false where metadata is thin or the likeness is doubtful
_fields.ai: true when an approved AI illustration is the portrait to ship; it must stay labeled and credited
